# Methods Research Lab

::: {.lead}
We study how researchers develop, test, and use research methods.
:::

Research methods decide what a study can show. We look at how methods are
developed, tested, chosen and reported, and we build practical resources that
other researchers can use.

## About the group {#about}

People from several institutions work together here on shared methods-research
projects. Most of us also run trials, systematic reviews or guideline work, and
we bring that experience into how we study methods.

Based at the University of Basel, with international collaborators across
several institutions.

We welcome collaboration with researchers interested in methods research.
